snippet.title: Bloodbath (Mac/PC Game) Playthrough
snippet.description:
A shooting gallery game from the '90s. I played the demo back in the day on my Mac Performa 475 33MHz. This video is from the DOS' PC version (which seems to be the Mac game running on an emulator).

I did some heavy cheating so I would get to see all the levels :) I saved the game after every checkpoint and edited the lives and sheriff stars with a hex editor. I took some pretty large liberties with the amounts as well, especially toward the latter levels, but still I lost almost 100 sheriff stars in those levels lol :)
